mentions.name: ikuyo
mentions.description: A travel planning web app that includes an activity calendar and an expense tracker. It is a pure static web page with its back-end handled by InstantDB. Planned features include adding a map, improving the UX for creating activities, and a to-do list; the builder has used it for a short trip and is targeting a 2-week trip in 6 months as a self-imposed deadline.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a travel planning application. I know a lot of other apps exist, but I'd like to build one myself.

https://github.com/kenrick95/ikuyo

So far it has some sort of activity calendar + expense tracker
